name: dsh-plugin-pace-hub
description: 节奏台 — a floating overlay hub for the pace-popups series. A draggable, position-persisted bar mounted on the app-global shell.overlay slot; v1a manages which pace popups (grasp / crosslens / jiyibi) are shown via a shared localStorage flag the popups honor live. Later versions host richer panels (记一笔 ledger browsing + read-only re-read). Zero-build hand-written client; no backend state in v1a.
